opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to direct applications from individual academics at risk in their home country or who have been recently displaced, regardless of nationality. Academics forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death.
opportunities.summary: Rescue fellowship programme that finds temporary refuge for at-risk academics in universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK), securing temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements. Provides placements, additional funding, visa help and practical support for the academic and accompanying family members. Awards are typically 2- or 3-year placements.
